name: slip
description: Private receipt book for USDG on Robinhood Chain. Pay someone — a salary, a week, a bill you owe — or send one link to get paid for a service. The book and the CSV stay behind a key. That link shows only that payment. A paid slip keeps the transaction hash. No account. 6 decimals. Gas is ETH.

scripts.test: tsx --test lib/money.test.ts lib/slug.test.ts lib/fee.test.ts lib/match-transfer.test.ts lib/receipts.test.ts
